paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

The compute cluster manages 512 Nvidia H100 GPUs distributed across 64 compute nodes connected via 800 Gbps InfiniBand fabric. The GPU device manager in `device_manager.cpp` partitions physical GPUs using Multi-Instance GPU configuration slicing each H100 into 4 isolated compute instances with dedicated high-bandwidth memory. For deep learning inference serving the Triton inference server cluster in `triton_orchestrator.cpp` configures dynamic batching with max queue delay set to 10 milliseconds and max batch size of 64 requests. Site reliability engineers must monitor GPU cluster health on the primary Prometheus dashboard tracking GPU utilization, tensor core throttling, and PCIe bus error rates. The GPU compute utilization threshold must remain above 85% across all active nodes during production training runs. If PCIe bus fatal error counters increment in nvidia-smi telemetry the cluster automated remediation agent in `node_drainer.py` must immediately cordon the affected compute node.

Job preemption policies in `priority_scheduler.cpp` allow high-priority real-time inference workloads to preempt background fine-tuning jobs with a 30-second checkpoint grace period. The infrastructure security architect mandates that tenant container runtimes enforce Nvidia container toolkit isolation preventing unprivileged access to host kernel modules. Network isolation policies in `calico_network.yaml` must enforce strict virtual private cloud segmentation restricting inter-node traffic to authorized tenant subnets. Audit logging agents in `security_audit.py` must record all privileged container execution events and send structured logs to /var/log/gpu_audit.log. The disaster recovery coordinator requires automated daily failover drills simulating loss of an entire compute rack with automated workload rescheduling completed within 5 minutes. The lead systems engineer mandates automated integration tests verifying that CUDA driver version 12.4 and NCCL library version 2.20 are standardized across all cluster worker images before deployment.

Thermal throttling monitors in `thermal_guard.cpp` must alert on-call hardware operators when GPU die temperature exceeds 80 degrees Celsius. Power capping configurations in `power_manager.py` must restrict maximum GPU power draw to 700 watts per board during peak power grid demand events. The machine learning operations director requires verifying sustained training throughput of 95% linear scaling across 256 GPUs before approving production rollout. The cluster scheduling coordinator in `cluster_coordinator.cpp` must implement gang scheduling to ensure all distributed training worker pods start simultaneously. Memory bandwidth throttling in `bandwidth_limiter.cpp` must restrict background data loader processes to 50 GB/s to avoid starving tensor core computations. The network telemetry monitor in `infiniband_monitor.py` must track link bit error rates across all optical transceiver cables alerting on signal degradation.

In addition automated container image caching in `image_cache.py` must pre-pull deep learning container images to local NVMe caches across all worker nodes. Site reliability engineers must configure automated Prometheus alert rules in `gpu_alerts.yaml` notifying on-call engineers when GPU memory utilization exceeds 95%. The cluster telemetry agent in `dcgm_exporter.py` must collect per-GPU metrics including tensor core utilization, DRAM memory frequency, and NVLink error counters every 5 seconds. The Chief Technology Officer requires that all deep learning training containers enforce strict CPU and memory limits preventing noisy neighbor interference.
